T:P2.2.text: Smart Sand Industrial Product Solutions At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures

T:P2.4.text: At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures we meet all your sand needs.

T:P2.5.text: Diverse Product Selection: From coarse to fine grains, we have it all.

T:P2.6.text: Extensive Shipping Network: With access to 6 railroads, we deliver across the USA, Canada, and Mexico.

T:P2.7.text: Flexible Loading and Shipping Options: We offer loading and shipping via “Bulk bag, 3000#”, high-speed truck loading for both pneumatic and bottom dump, and bulk shipping via rail.

T:P2.8.text: Custom Solutions: Offering custom blending and in-house packaging to suit your specific requirements.

T:P2.9.text: SmartSand is dedicated to the industrial market, ensuring a consistent, long-term supply of high-quality sand at competitive prices. Our industrial team, boasting over 100 years of combined experience, is committed to providing exceptional products to markets worldwide. Utilizing in-house state of the art technology for gradation, ADV, pH, LOI, Moisture, and XRF (Powder/Pellet).

T:P2.10.text: Our rapid expansion is a testament to our strategic commitment and the trust our customers place in us. Partnering with SmartSand means discovering a new way of doing business, one that sets you apart from the competition.

C:P1.2.text: As a small, US-based company, we ensure your success by delivering high quality products on time, in full and at a fair value, regardless of market conditions. Intrepid offers tailored solutions, responding to your needs with speed and agility. We will earn your trust by acting with integrity and consistency, becoming a valued member of your team of suppliers.

C:P1.3.text: Intrepid delivers high quality potassium, magnesium, sulfur, salt and water essential for customer success in agriculture, animal feed and the oil and gas industry.

C:P2.2.text: Intrepid is the only producer of potash and potassium chloride products based in the USA, supplying approximately 9% of domestic annual consumption for use in agriculture, animal feed and industry

C:P2.3.text: Intrepid delivers high quality potassium, magnesium, sulfur and salt essential for success in agriculture, animal feed and industry.
